name: Auth: countries codes may be sent to
description: ISO country codes whose phone numbers may be spent on at all (e.g. ["RU","KZ"]). Aimed at IRSF: premium numbers in countries you never serve are the usual way an OTP form is turned into revenue for somebody else. Refused numbers are told why, so a legitimate foreign visitor knows what happened. Note that +7 is one calling code for both Russia and Kazakhstan, so allowing either allows both. Left empty, this falls back to the project's own COUNTRY_ISO setting rather than allowing every country — set this explicitly (even to the same single country) once you actually want to serve more than one.
